Refresh Our Environment

改善我们的环境 · 187 词 · 2 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1As the director stated on behalf of his research group, the data in this graph clearly show possible future environmental trends. On the one hand, the quantity of fuel available is falling by 9% per year, while many kinds of pollution are becoming more widespread around the world. On the other hand, the slow but steady rise in average temperatures is contributing to catastrophes such as widespread floods. They subscribe to the view that human activity and the careless consumption of energy are causing this phenomenon.

2Many people are convinced that developing nuclear power or using energy from outer space will prevent harmful consequences. However, scientists and educators are opposed to this view even if our needs may be met on the whole. They tend to advocate improving the environment by saving energy and recycling waste. They recommend using energy-saving appliances such as efficient electric motors and microwave ovens. They also suggest that we not be casual about small things like recycling a can. So please glance around and see what you can do. If everybody makes a contribution, we can deal with this problem more effectively.

改善我们的环境

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1主任代表研究小组发言时说，这张图的数据清楚地显示了未来可能出现的环境变化趋势。一方面，可用燃料的数量每年减少 9%，多种污染也在全球变得更加普遍。另一方面，平均气温缓慢而持续地上升，是大范围洪水等灾害的成因之一。研究人员认为，人类活动和不加节制地消耗能源造成了这种现象。

2很多人坚信，开发核能或者利用来自太空的能源就能避免坏结果。不过，即使总体上的能源需求有可能得到满足，科学家和教育工作者仍反对这种看法。他们主张用节约能源和回收废弃物来改善环境。建议大家使用节能电器，例如省电的电动机和微波炉，也别忽视回收一个易拉罐这样的小事。不妨看看四周，想想自己能做什么。只要人人都出一份力，我们就能更好地应对这个问题。
